title: Short Sword
description: A lightweight PvP-focused resource pack that shortens swords for maximum screen visibility and cleaner combat
body:
# **Short Sword** A lightweight resource pack that shortens all swords to give you better visibility and maximum screen space during PvP. Works perfectly on almost all versions and can be used as an overlay!
*** ## What this project does * **Shortens Sword Models:** It shrinks the default size of all swords in Minecraft to prevent them from blocking your view. * **Enhances PvP Sight:** Gives you a much clearer view of your opponents during intense combat ## Why you should download it * **Vanilla-Friendly:** It retains the classic, familiar texture style of standard Minecraft swords just shorter! * **Performance Friendly:** Extremely lightweight, meaning it has absolutely zero impact on your FPS. * **Overlay Support:** You don't need to change your main resource pack; just place this on top of any pack. ## ⚠️ Critical Information & How to Use * **How to Install:** Download the pack, place it in your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder, and activate it in-game. * **Overlay Setup:** For the best experience, make sure to move this pack to the **very top** of your selected resource packs list so it overrides other sword textures properly. *** ## Available Editions There are two versions included in this short sword resource pack: * **Default Tip Edition** – Keeps the original sharp point but shrinks the blade. * **Flat Tip Edition** – Cuts off the top for a clean, flat look. *** ## Gallery ![Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e7e530003ba83cc7a898540999b11c9b8412631_0.webp)
